text:
max: Heads up — noticed a batch of SCIM deprovisioning events failing since ~03:10 UTC. Appears tied to KMS decrypt errors after an RBAC/alias change.
tara: saw the alert, prometheus shows repeated 403 from kms-wrapper when unwrapping envelopes :grimacing:
samir: dumping logs from the worker: 
```
2026-03-21T03:12:05Z scim-provisioner ERROR unwrap failed: AccessDenied: user "svc/scim-worker" missing kms:Decrypt on alias/ri-cmk-prod
2026-03-21T03:12:07Z scim-provisioner INFO retrying envelope id=env_7f4a
```
iris: any recent CMK alias swaps or policy edits?
max: ops did a manual alias rebind this morning as part of RBAC cleanup. I flagged it but didn't expect side effects.
engsec-oncall: triage notes: SCIM queue is backing up (~290 failed unwraps), audit logs show missing decrypted payloads between 03:10-03:22 UTC. Runbook link posted: https://internal.runbooks/ssoprovision#kms (internal)
tara: short-term mitigation — regrant `kms:Decrypt` to `svc/scim-worker` on alias/ri-cmk-prod and restart the scim-provisioner canary. I'll attempt a canary first.
samir: if perms can't be changed quickly, we have a fallback path that can try cached envelope keys. Patch suggestion (short):
```
try {
  return kms.decrypt(envelope)
} catch (e) {
  log.warn('kms decrypt failed, trying cached_key')
  return cached_key.unwrap(envelope)
}
```
max: separate but related: noticed some OIDC id_token rejections around same time — `azp` claim mismatches after an Azure AD conditional-access tweak, which caused a few webhook-auth failures. Could be orthogonal but probably amplified the incident.
iris: can someone confirm Azure AD app registration roles/permissions? Maybe the app lost a delegated permission needed for webhook auth.
engsec-oncall: rolling permission change now. Tara, please confirm when done and post an updated last_message_ts so we know remediation started.
deploy-bot: deploy started: scim-provisioner v2.14.3 by tara at 2026-03-21T03:25:00Z :rocket:
tara: applied `kms:Decrypt` back to svc/scim-worker and restarted scim-provisioner canary — first 10 unwraps succeeded, queue is draining :thumbsup:
max: audit logs now showing decrypted attributes again. We still have ~280 entries that never got decrypted — need a backfill to recreate audit entries and ensure compliance retention.
samir: I’ll write a backfill that reprocesses failed envelope IDs and re-emits audit log entries (idempotent). ETA ~1h. Assigning to myself and will ping when done.
iris: also schedule a short postmortem to tighten RBAC/alias swap checklist. We should require a staged permission grant before alias swaps.
engsec-oncall: agreed. Action items: 1) Backfill by samir, 2) Postmortem & RBAC checklist, 3) Improve fallback decrypt path + observability. I opened incident INC-2026-328 and added assignees.
max: thanks all — keep updates here. Closing after backfill finishes and we confirm audit parity :white_check_mark:
